title: ASIA FM Taiwan Inc
description: ASIA FM Taiwan Inc. (officially known in Chinese as Asia Broadcasting Co., Ltd., and commonly referred to as the Asia Broadcasting Network or Asia Radio Family) is a highly influential private regional commercial radio network in northern Taiwan. Headquartered in Taoyuan City, the station’s signal primarily covers Keelung, the Greater Taipei area, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, and Miaoli County, and has consistently maintained extremely high listenership ratings in the Taoyuan-Hsinchu-Miaoli region.
